Head_and_Face: Head is broad and deep with pronounced cheek muscles, moderate stop, and medium-length muzzle.
Eyes are round, dark, and set wide apart with alert expression.
Ears are set high, may be cropped or natural (rose or half-pricked).
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is short, close-lying, stiff, and glossy.
Coloration is highly variable: solid, parti-color, or patched in any color except liver, black-and-tan, or merle.
Body is stocky and heavily muscled with broad chest measuring 43-48 cm at shoulder.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight, heavy-boned, and well-muscled with round compact feet.
Tail is medium-length, low-set, tapering, and carried straight.
Gait is free, powerful, and agile.

Head_and_Face: Head is narrow and arched with Roman nose (convex profile) and minimal stop.
Ears are moderate-sized, triangular, set low, and hanging flat with silky fringe.
Eyes are small, deep-set, and triangular, color ranging from light amber to dark brown.
Body_and_Plumage: Distinctive linty, crisp coat texture, a mix of hard and soft hairs.
Coat ranges from blue, sandy, liver, or blue-and-tan.
Body is arched over loin with roached topline measuring 38-43 cm at shoulder.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight and long with hare feet.
Tail is moderate-length, low-set, tapering, and carried with slight curve.
Gait is free, elastic, and springy.

Head_and_Face: Head is otter-shaped: broad skull with moderate stop and short strong muzzle.
Ears are V-shaped, medium-sized, set high, and hanging forward close to cheeks.
Dark muzzle (mask) is characteristic.
Body_and_Plumage: Double-layered coat: dense short undercoat with harsh wiry outer coat, close-lying and weather-resistant.
Coloration is red, grizzle-and-tan, blue-and-tan, or wheaten.
Body is narrow and deep-chested measuring 28-41 cm at shoulder.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight and moderate-length with small compact feet.
Tail is moderate-length, set high, thick at base, tapering, and carried gaily.
Narrow chest and long legs distinguish from other small terriers.

Head_and_Face: Head is long and flat with moderate stop and strong square muzzle.
Ears are V-shaped, small, set high, and folded forward close to cheeks.
Eyes are dark, small, and alert with keen expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Silky blue-grey coat that darkens with maturity (puppies born black, transitioning to blue-grey by 18 months).
Coat is soft, dense, wavy, and silky, never wiry, covering entire body including legs and head.
Body is well-proportioned and muscular measuring 44-49 cm at shoulder.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight and muscular with round compact feet.
Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried erect.
Gait is free, smooth, and effortless.

Head_and_Face: Head is long and flat with slight stop and strong muzzle.
Ears are V-shaped, small, set high, and folded forward close to cheeks.
Eyes are dark brown, small, and alert with fiery expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Solid rich red, red-wheaten, or golden-red coat coloration.
Coat is dense, harsh, wiry, and close-lying with slight beard and furnishings on legs.
Body is racy and well-proportioned measuring 46-48 cm at shoulder.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight, muscular, and moderate-length with small compact feet.
Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried gaily.
Gait is free, active, and ground-covering.

Head_and_Face: Head is slightly rounded with moderate stop and strong wedge-shaped muzzle.
Ears are medium-sized, V-shaped, set high, and folded forward close to cheeks (dropped).
Eyes are oval, dark, and alert with keen expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is straight, wiry, hard-textured, and close-lying.
Coloration ranges from red, wheaten, black-and-tan, or grizzle.
Body is compact and sturdy with short back measuring 23-25 cm at shoulder.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are short, straight, and sturdy with round compact feet.
Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried moderately high.
Dropped ears distinguish from Norwich terrier.

Head_and_Face: Head is slightly rounded with moderate stop and strong wedge-shaped muzzle.
Ears are small, pointed, set high, and carried erect.
Eyes are oval, dark, and alert with keen expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Coat is straight, wiry, hard-textured, and close-lying.
Coloration ranges from red, wheaten, black-and-tan, or grizzle.
Body is compact and sturdy with short back measuring 23-25 cm at shoulder.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are short, straight, and sturdy with round compact feet.
Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried moderately high.
Erect ears distinguish from Norfolk terrier.

Head_and_Face: Head is small and flat with moderate stop and medium-length muzzle.
Ears are small, V-shaped, set high, and carried erect.
Eyes are medium-sized, dark, and sparkling with alert expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Long, straight, silky coat in distinctive blue-grey and tan coloration.
Steel blue on body and tail, rich golden tan on head, chest, and legs.
Coat parts along spine from head to tail and should reach floor when untrimmed.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight with black toenails and round compact feet.
Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, carried slightly above horizontal.
Gait is free, brisk, and animated.

Head_and_Face: Head is flat and narrow with moderate stop and strong muzzle.
Ears are V-shaped, small, set high, and folded forward close to cheeks.
Eyes are dark, small, round, and alert with keen expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Dense, harsh, wiry outer coat with softer undercoat, standing off from body.
Coloration is predominantly white with black, tan, or black-and-tan markings.
Body should be mostly white with colored markings on head and hindquarters.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight, muscular, and moderate-length with small compact feet.
Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried gaily.
Wiry coat texture distinguishes from smooth fox terrier.

Head_and_Face: Head is flat and moderately broad with slight stop and strong muzzle.
Ears are V-shaped, small, set high, and folded forward close to cheeks.
Eyes are dark hazel or brown, small, and alert with keen expression.
Body_and_Plumage: Dense, harsh, wiry outer coat with soft undercoat, close-lying and weather-resistant.
Coloration is blue, black, liver, red, orange, wheaten, red-grizzle, blue-grizzle, or tan.
Dark saddle pattern common.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are straight, muscular, and moderate-length with small compact feet.
Tail is docked (traditionally) or natural, set high, carried gaily.
Smaller and more refined than Welsh terrier.
